; FIXED BANKS 30/31 ($C000-$FFFF, always mapped; MMC3 PRG mode 0).
; Kernel: reset, NMI/IRQ, far calls between 16 KiB units, inline jump-table
; dispatch, VRAM/palette/OAM services, controllers, math helpers, sound-effect
; front end (DMC samples), camera/scroll control, field map (radar) drawing and
; some score bookkeeping. $D5C0-$FD40 is mostly DPCM sample data.
; Unit id byte = 30 (the bank number). FarCall reads it at $8000 to remember which unit
; to restore; Reset checks the fixed bank's copy.
; PowerOnInit  ($C001, physical 0x3C011; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; Power-on initialisation after Reset: vertical mirroring, PPUCTRL shadow with sprites
; at $1000, NMI and rendering off, both nametables cleared, sound reset, GameMode 3
; (front end) with sub-mode 0, Var65 = 4. Reads the controllers once; the A+B test that
; follows has no effect because both paths continue at ModeTransition (probably a
; removed debug hook).
; Entry: jumped to from Reset.
; Calls ResetSound, ClearNametables, NullRoutine, ReadJoypads, DisableRendering,
; DisableNmi. Touches MMC3 registers. Reads JoyHeld. Writes GameMode, GameSubMode,
; MirroringShadow, Var65, PpuCtrlShadow.
; both paths continue at ModeTransition (A+B check has no effect)
; ModeTransition  ($C032, physical 0x3C042; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; Runs the init handler (unit entry 0) of the current GameMode with NMI and rendering
; disabled, repeating while the handler sets bit 7 again. Also sets
; IrqSplitEnable/ChrA12Invert to $80 before init (the handler may change them),
; recomputes ScrollYPpu, clears the VRAM buffer and pending palette upload, waits for
; vblank and re-enables rendering and NMI.
; Entry: jumped to from MainLoop.
; Calls RunModeInit, WaitVblank, ConvertScrollY, EnableRendering, DisableRendering,
; EnableNmi, DisableNmi. Touches the VRAM update buffer. Reads GameMode. Writes
; GameMode, NmiSync, IrqSplitEnable, PaletteDirty, ChrA12Invert.
; no IRQs during the mode switch
; MainLoop  ($C063, physical 0x3C073; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; Main loop, one pass per NMI frame. Waits for NmiSync bit 0, counts LoopCounter, reads
; and maps controllers, runs the unit-22 per-frame service, then either the pause
; handler (Start in GameMode 2 under the conditions below) or the normal frame:
; OamCursor = 4, mode frame handler, hide unused sprites, play clock and random step. A
; set GameMode bit 7 leaves through ModeTransition.
; Entry: jumped to from MainLoop.
; Calls ModeTransition, MainLoop, MapControllersToSides, RunModeFrame, RunUnit22Service,
; HideUnusedSprites, NextRandom, ReadJoypads (+2 more). Reads GameMode, NmiSync,
; JoyPressed, PauseState, PitchPhase, BatterState, ObjectTable, SideMapMode, SideSwap.
; Writes LoopCounter, GameMode, GameSubMode, NmiSync, PauseState, OamCursor.
; wait for the NMI to finish a frame
; clear bit 0, keep bit 7
; paused?
; Start pressed during play?
; sprite 0 stays reserved
; object 0 state $11 (tentative: pitcher ready)
; pause only once PitchPhase >= $30
; NMI  ($C131, physical 0x3C141; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; Vblank handler. Rejects early NMIs until ResetSignature is set. Order: OAM DMA,
; PPUMASK; if FarCall is mid-switch (NmiSync bit 7) only scroll, CHR banks and IRQ are
; refreshed. Otherwise uploads the palette or flushes VramBuffer, sets scroll, starts a
; delayed DMC sample, writes CHR banks, arms the IRQ split, writes mirroring, then
; (saving FarCallIndex/Unit) draws or erases the pause TIME label or runs the mode's NMI
; handler, updates sound, bumps FrameCounter and terminates VramBuffer. Finally sets
; NmiSync bit 0; if the NMI interrupted a FarCall bank switch, it restarts that step
; instead of returning (InterruptRestartFarCall).
; Entry: NMI vector.
; Calls ArmIrqSplit, RunModeNmi, FlushVramBuffer, UploadPalette, ApplyScroll,
; WriteChrBanks, RunDmcDelay, Reset. Touches PPU registers, APU registers, MMC3
; registers. Reads NmiSync, FarCallIndex, FarCallUnit, MirroringShadow, PauseState,
; PpuMaskShadow, PaletteDirty, ResetSignature. Writes VramBufIndex, PaletteDirty,
; IrqSplitStep.
; ResetSignature present?
; OAM DMA from OamBuffer ($0700)
; FarCall mid-switch: minimal NMI
; the NMI handlers below use FarCall
; NmiSoundAndFinish  ($C18D, physical 0x3C19D; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; NMI tail: one sound-driver tick (unit 8 entry 2) unless a DMC sample is playing or
; SoundBusy is set, FrameCounter++, VramBuffer terminator, restore FarCall arguments,
; signal the frame and return.
; Entry: jumped to from NmiPauseLabel.
; Calls NmiSignalFrame, InterruptRestartFarCall, ArmIrqSplit, ApplyScroll,
; WriteChrBanks. Far-calls U08_SndUpdate. Touches APU registers, MMC3 registers, the
; VRAM update buffer. Reads NmiSync, MirroringShadow, SoundBusy, VramBufIndex,
; FarCallStage. Writes FrameCounter, NmiSync, FarCallIndex, FarCallUnit, SoundBusy.
; a DMC sample is playing: skip the sound tick
; far call: unit 8 entry 2 = U08_SndUpdate
; Common NMI exit: signal the finished frame, then return or restart an interrupted
; FarCall step.
; NMI path while FarCall is switching banks: only scroll, CHR banks and the IRQ split
; are refreshed.
; InterruptRestartFarCall  ($C1E1, physical 0x3C1F1; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; Entered from NMI/IRQ exit with A = FarCallStage (1 or 4) when the interrupt hit
; FarCall while it was writing MMC3 bank registers. The handler's own MMC3_BANK_SELECT
; writes would corrupt that sequence, so the saved return address is replaced by the
; start of the interrupted step (FarCallRestartPoints) and the interrupt returns there
; to redo the bank writes.
; Entry: jumped to from NmiSignalFrame, IrqExit, IrqApplyChrSplitInverted.
; drop the 3 saved registers and the old frame
; push the restart address (FarCallRestartPoints)
; Two restart addresses inside FarCall (target selection at $C871, caller restore at
; $C8AF), indexed by FarCallStage/2 in InterruptRestartFarCall.
; NMI path while paused: queue the TIME label (PauseState 1) or erase it (PauseState >=
; ArmIrqSplit  ($C212, physical 0x3C222; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; Arms the MMC3 scanline IRQ with IrqSplitLine when IrqSplitEnable is nonzero (and
; enables CPU IRQs); otherwise disables the MMC3 IRQ.
; Entry: called by NMI, NmiFarCallActive.
; Touches MMC3 registers. Reads IrqSplitEnable, IrqSplitLine.
; IRQ  ($C227, physical 0x3C237; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; MMC3 scanline IRQ: counts IrqCount, acknowledges the IRQ, checks ResetSignature and
; continues in IrqSplitHandler.
; Entry: IRQ vector.
; Calls Reset, IrqSplitHandler. Touches MMC3 registers. Reads ResetSignature. Writes
; IrqCount.
; acknowledge the MMC3 IRQ
; IrqApplyChrSplit  ($C23E, physical 0x3C24E; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; Default split: loads CHR registers R0-R5 from ChrSplitNibbles. The register order
; depends on ChrA12Invert (two variants), then returns from the interrupt.
; Entry: jumped to from IrqSplitHandler.
; Calls IrqApplyChrSplitInverted. Touches MMC3 registers. Reads ChrSplitNibbles,
; ChrA12Invert.
; IrqExit  ($C2A6, physical 0x3C2B6; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; Common IRQ exit: restores registers, or restarts an interrupted FarCall bank switch.
; Entry: jumped to from IrqSplitHandler, IrqSplitSubMode0A.
; Calls InterruptRestartFarCall. Reads FarCallStage.
; IrqApplyChrSplitInverted  ($C2B4, physical 0x3C2C4; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; IrqApplyChrSplit for ChrA12Invert = 0: the 2 KiB registers take the slot pairs $58/$5C
; and the 1 KiB registers $50-$57.
; Entry: jumped to from IrqApplyChrSplit.
; Calls InterruptRestartFarCall. Touches MMC3 registers. Reads ChrSplitNibbles,
; FarCallStage.
; MapControllersToSides  ($C31A, physical 0x3C32A; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; Copies JoyPressed/JoyHeld into SidePressed/SideHeld so index 0 is the side to act.
; With SideMapMode = 0 the swap follows (HalfInning xor SideSwap) bit 0; otherwise only
; the half-inning parity is used. Probably maps the batting/fielding team to the
; controller that owns it.
; Entry: called by MainLoop.
; Reads JoyPressed, JoyHeld, SideMapMode, HalfInning, SideSwap. Writes SidePressed,
; SideHeld.
; RunModeInit  ($C352, physical 0x3C362; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; Calls the init handler (unit entry 0) of GameMode 1/2/3 after clearing ChrA12Invert.
; Mode 0 does nothing.
; Entry: called by ModeTransition.
; Ends in an inline jump-table dispatch on A. Reads GameMode. Writes ChrA12Invert.
; dispatch on A; the jump table follows
; Inline jump table read by the dispatcher called just above (index in A, 2-byte
; little-endian handler addresses).
; case 0
; case 1
; case 2
; case 3
; ModeInitNone  ($C366, physical 0x3C376; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; GameMode 0: no handler.
; Entry: case 0 of RunModeInit_Cases.
; ModeInit1  ($C367, physical 0x3C377; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; GameMode 1: far-calls the init handler (entry 0) of unit 26.
; Entry: case 1 of RunModeInit_Cases.
; Far-calls U26_Mode1Init. Writes FarCallIndex, FarCallUnit, ChrA12Invert.
; far call: unit 26 entry 0 = U26_Mode1Init
; ModeInit2  ($C378, physical 0x3C388; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; GameMode 2: far-calls the init handler (entry 0) of unit 28.
; Entry: case 2 of RunModeInit_Cases.
; Far-calls U28_Mode2Init. Writes FarCallIndex, FarCallUnit, ChrA12Invert.
; far call: unit 28 entry 0 = U28_Mode2Init
; ModeInit3  ($C389, physical 0x3C399; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; GameMode 3: far-calls the init handler (entry 0) of unit 20.
; Entry: case 3 of RunModeInit_Cases.
; Far-calls U20_Mode3Init. Writes FarCallIndex, FarCallUnit, ChrA12Invert.
; far call: unit 20 entry 0 = U20_Mode3Init
; RunModeFrame  ($C399, physical 0x3C3A9; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; Calls the per-frame handler (unit entry 1) of the current GameMode.
; Entry: called by MainLoop.
; Ends in an inline jump-table dispatch on A. Reads GameMode.
; dispatch on A; the jump table follows
; Inline jump table read by the dispatcher called just above (index in A, 2-byte
; little-endian handler addresses).
; case 0
; case 1
; case 2
; case 3
; ModeFrameNone  ($C3A8, physical 0x3C3B8; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; GameMode 0: no handler.
; Entry: case 0 of RunModeFrame_Cases.
; ModeFrame1  ($C3A9, physical 0x3C3B9; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; GameMode 1: far-calls the per-frame handler (entry 1) of unit 26.
; Entry: case 1 of RunModeFrame_Cases.
; Far-calls U26_Mode1Frame. Writes FarCallIndex, FarCallUnit.
; far call: unit 26 entry 1 = U26_Mode1Frame
; ModeFrame2  ($C3B5, physical 0x3C3C5; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; GameMode 2: far-calls the per-frame handler (entry 1) of unit 28.
; Entry: case 2 of RunModeFrame_Cases.
; Far-calls U28_Mode2Frame. Writes FarCallIndex, FarCallUnit.
; far call: unit 28 entry 1 = U28_Mode2Frame
; ModeFrame3  ($C3C1, physical 0x3C3D1; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; GameMode 3: far-calls the per-frame handler (entry 1) of unit 20.
; Entry: case 3 of RunModeFrame_Cases.
; Far-calls U20_Mode3Frame. Writes FarCallIndex, FarCallUnit.
; far call: unit 20 entry 1 = U20_Mode3Frame
; RunModeNmi  ($C3CD, physical 0x3C3DD; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; From the NMI: calls the mode's vblank handler (unit entry 2) unless GameMode bit 7
; (initialisation pending) is set.
; Entry: called by NMI.
; Ends in an inline jump-table dispatch on A. Reads GameMode.
; dispatch on A; the jump table follows
; Inline jump table read by the dispatcher called just above (index in A, 2-byte
; little-endian handler addresses).
; case 0
; case 1
; case 2
; case 3
; ModeNmiNone  ($C3DE, physical 0x3C3EE; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; GameMode 0: no handler.
; Entry: case 0 of RunModeNmi_Cases.
; ModeNmi1  ($C3DF, physical 0x3C3EF; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; GameMode 1: far-calls the NMI handler (entry 2) of unit 26.
; Entry: case 1 of RunModeNmi_Cases.
; Far-calls U26_Mode1Nmi. Writes FarCallIndex, FarCallUnit.
; far call: unit 26 entry 2 = U26_Mode1Nmi
; ModeNmi2  ($C3EB, physical 0x3C3FB; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; GameMode 2: far-calls the NMI handler (entry 2) of unit 28.
; Entry: case 2 of RunModeNmi_Cases.
; Far-calls U28_Mode2Nmi. Writes FarCallIndex, FarCallUnit.
; far call: unit 28 entry 2 = U28_Mode2Nmi
; ModeNmi3  ($C3F7, physical 0x3C407; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; GameMode 3: far-calls the NMI handler (entry 2) of unit 20.
; Entry: case 3 of RunModeNmi_Cases.
; Far-calls U20_Mode3Nmi. Writes FarCallIndex, FarCallUnit.
; far call: unit 20 entry 2 = U20_Mode3Nmi
; ResetSound  ($C403, physical 0x3C413; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; Calls the sound unit's init (unit 8 entry 0) and marks the DMC channel idle
; (DmcCurrent/DmcDelay/DmcAddress/DmcLength = $FF).
; Entry: called by U18_InitSceneSeason, U18_PennantColors, U20_InitOptions,
; U20_InitTitle, U20_InitTeamSelect, U20_InitSoundTest (+14 more).
; Far-calls U08_SndInit. Writes FarCallIndex, FarCallUnit, DmcCurrent, DmcDelay,
; DmcAddress, DmcLength.
; far call: unit 8 entry 0 = U08_SndInit
; PlaySound  ($C41D, physical 0x3C42D; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; Requests sound id A from the sound unit (unit 8 entry 1). Ids $18-$28 and >= $2D are
; music: they are ignored while MusicOff is set and remembered in CurrentMusic.
; SoundBusy prevents re-entering the sound unit from the NMI.
; Entry: called by U12_MenuPickFirst, U12_MenuPickGameType, U12_MenuPickSeason,
; U12_MenuPickExhibition, U16_PasswordEditor, U16_PasswordEditInput (+39 more); jumped
; to from U20_InitTitle, U20_InitTeamSelect, U20_InitPasswordShow,
; U20_InitPasswordEntry, U20_InitEnding, U20_LineupPickSecond (+10 more).
; Far-calls U08_SndStart. Reads SoundBusy, MusicOff. Writes FarCallIndex, FarCallUnit,
; SoundBusy, SoundRequest, CurrentMusic.
; far call: unit 8 entry 1 = U08_SndStart
; QueuePauseTimeLabel  ($C44D, physical 0x3C45D; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; Queues the 4 tiles 'TIME' (tile = letter + $80) at nametable $228E: the pause label.
; Entry: called by NmiPauseLabel.
; Touches the VRAM update buffer. Reads VramBufIndex. Writes VramBufIndex.
; QueuePauseBlankLabel  ($C47C, physical 0x3C48C; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; Queues 4 blank tiles ($01) over the pause label at $228E.
; Entry: called by NmiPauseLabel.
; Touches the VRAM update buffer. Reads VramBufIndex. Writes VramBufIndex.
; RunUnit22Service  ($C4A5, physical 0x3C4B5; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; Per-frame far call from the main loop (every mode) to unit 22 entry 12,
; U22_CpuInputService: generates controller input for CPU-controlled sides and the
; attract demo.
; Entry: called by MainLoop.
; Far-calls U22_CpuInputService. Touches PPU registers. Reads PpuCtrlShadow. Writes
; FarCallIndex, FarCallUnit.
; far call: unit 22 entry 12 = U22_CpuInputService
; FlushVramBuffer  ($C4CF, physical 0x3C4DF; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; NMI-time VRAM upload of VramBuffer. The stack pointer is temporarily set to $FF so
; each pla reads the next buffer byte from $0100 upward (fast sequential read). Records:
; address high (0 terminates), address low, control byte, data. Control < $80:
; horizontal run of control+1 bytes; $80-$BF: same with the PPU +32 increment (vertical
; column); >= $C0: (control&$3F)+1 bytes written 8 bytes apart (an attribute-table
; column). Runs are copied 8 bytes at a time plus the remainder.
; Entry: called by U26_PaintFieldView, NMI.
; Calls FlushNextRecord. Touches PPU registers. Reads SavedSP, PpuCtrlShadow,
; VramRunRemainder. Writes SavedSP, VramRunRemainder.
; stack now reads VramBuffer from $0100
; control >= $C0: attribute column
; WaitVblank  ($C54A, physical 0x3C55A; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; Waits for the start of a vblank by polling PPUSTATUS bit 7 (first for it to clear,
; then to set).
; Entry: called by ModeTransition.
; Touches PPU registers.
; UploadPalette  ($C554, physical 0x3C564; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; Copies the 32-byte PaletteBuffer to PPU $3F00, resets the PPU address and applies the
; scroll.
; Entry: called by NMI.
; Calls ApplyScroll. Touches PPU registers.
; ApplyScroll  ($C580, physical 0x3C590; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; Writes ScrollX/ScrollYPpu low bytes to PPUSCROLL and their bit 8 to the PPUCTRL
; nametable bits (also stored in PpuCtrlShadow).
; Entry: called by NMI, NmiFarCallActive; jumped to from UploadPalette.
; Touches PPU registers. Reads PpuCtrlShadow, ScrollX, ScrollYPpu. Writes PpuCtrlShadow.
; WriteChrBanks  ($C5A8, physical 0x3C5B8; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; Writes MMC3 CHR registers R0-R5 from ChrBankNibbles (two 2 KiB and four 1 KiB banks).
; The pairing of nibble slots to registers depends on ChrA12Invert.
; Entry: called by NMI, NmiFarCallActive.
; Calls WriteChrBank1K, WriteChrBank2K. Reads ChrA12Invert.
; WriteChrBank1K  ($C5F1, physical 0x3C601; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; Selects the next MMC3 register (X+1, ORed with ChrA12Invert via the caller's X) and
; writes bank = high nibble byte <<4 | low nibble byte from ChrBankNibbles+Y.
; Entry: called by WriteChrBanks.
; Touches MMC3 registers. Reads ChrBankNibbles.
; WriteChrBank2K  ($C603, physical 0x3C613; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; Same as WriteChrBank1K but clears bit 0 (2 KiB CHR registers R0/R1).
; Entry: called by WriteChrBanks.
; Touches MMC3 registers. Reads ChrBankNibbles.
; JumpTableDispatchZp  ($C617, physical 0x3C627; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; Inline jump table dispatch using Tmp00/Tmp01 as the pointer (safe to use from NMI
; context while the main thread uses JumpTableDispatch). Input A = case index. Pops the
; caller's return address, reads the word at return+1+2*A and jumps there; the caller
; never resumes after its jsr.
; Entry: called by U16_AtBatPanelStep, U20_Mode3Nmi, U20_LineupDrawStep,
; U20_SubstitutionDrawStep, U28_Mode2Nmi, RunModeNmi.
; ConvertScrollY  ($C62E, physical 0x3C63E; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; Builds ScrollYPpu from ScrollY: the virtual vertical scroll is continuous, but every
; 240 lines one nametable ends, so 16 lines are added per completed 240-line screen
; (ScrollYPpuSkip table). Seven thresholds cover ScrollY up to $3C0.
; Entry: called by U26_PaintFieldView, U26_Mode1Nmi, ModeTransition.
; Reads ScrollY. Writes ScrollYPpu.
; Lines added to ScrollY per completed 240-line screen (0, 16, 32 ... 112) for
; ConvertScrollY.
; ResetScroll  ($C67C, physical 0x3C68C; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; Zeroes ScrollY, ScrollX and ScrollYPpu.
; Entry: called by U20_Mode3Init, U28_InitAtBat, U28_InitCutsceneOne,
; U28_InitCutsceneTwo.
; Writes ScrollY, ScrollX, ScrollYPpu.
; UpdateScroll  ($C68B, physical 0x3C69B; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; Applies the camera speeds: ScrollY += ScrollVelY clamped to 0..$3C0 and ScrollX +=
; ScrollVelX clamped to 0..$6FF.
; Entry: called by U26_PaintFieldView, U26_Mode1Nmi.
; Calls ApplyScrollVelY, ApplyScrollVelX.
; ApplyScrollVelY  ($C691, physical 0x3C6A1; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; ScrollY += signed ScrollVelY, clamped to 0..$3C0.
; Entry: called by UpdateScroll.
; Reads ScrollY, ScrollVelY. Writes ScrollY.
; ApplyScrollVelX  ($C6D4, physical 0x3C6E4; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; ScrollX += signed ScrollVelX, clamped to 0..$6FF.
; Entry: jumped to from UpdateScroll.
; Reads ScrollX, ScrollVelX. Writes ScrollX.
; ClearObjectRecord  ($C715, physical 0x3C725; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; Zeroes bytes 1..19 of the object record at ObjPtr (byte 0 is kept).
; Entry: called by U22_BatterRunnerState, U22_UmpireClear, U22_UmpireStanding,
; U26_GiveBallToFielder, U26_StartBackstopRoll, U26_FielderInit.
; Writes ObjPtr.
; HideUnusedSprites  ($C721, physical 0x3C731; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; Moves every OAM shadow entry from OamCursor to the end off-screen (Y = $F8), and
; sprite 0 too.
; Entry: called by U20_Mode3Init, U26_Mode1InitDispatch, U28_Mode2InitDispatch,
; MainLoop.
; Touches the OAM shadow page. Reads OamCursor. Writes OamBuffer.
; JumpTableDispatch  ($C734, physical 0x3C744; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; Inline jump table dispatch. Input A = case index. Pops the caller's return address
; into Arg10/Arg11, fetches the word at return+1+2*A and jumps to it. The table of
; 2-byte handler addresses follows the caller's jsr, so the caller never resumes. Bounds
; are not checked.
; Entry: called by U12_TitleMenuDispatch, U20_Mode3Init, U20_Mode3Frame,
; U20_LineupScreenStep, U20_SubstitutionMenu, U20_PitcherChangeMenu (+38 more).
; DrawMetasprite  ($C74B, physical 0x3C75B; fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF)
; Appends a metasprite to the OAM shadow at OamCursor. Inputs: Arg10/11 = sprite list,
; Arg12 = X, Arg13 = Y+1 (0 = do not draw), Arg14 = attribute XOR mask (bit 6 also
; mirrors X offsets). List records are 4 bytes (dy, tile, attr, dx; dy=$80 ends). Pieces
; whose position wraps off-screen are skipped; stops when the OAM page is full.
; Entry: called by U10_CloseupAnimateA, U10_PitcherCloseupStrikeout,
; U10_CloseupAnimateB, U16_DrawCutsceneSprites, U16_DrawMatchupEmblems,

; Calls U06_FieldAttrTableBase. Reads FieldVramAddr, ScrollX, ScrollYPpu, ScrollVelY.
; Writes FieldVramAddr.
; U06_FieldAttrTableBase  ($849B, physical 0x0C4AB; unit 6 (banks 6/7 at $8000-$BFFF; fixed 30/31 above))
; Tmp00/01 = $23C0 or $27C0 from ScrollX bit 8.
; Entry: called by U06_FieldAttrRowVramAddr.
; Reads ScrollX.
; U06_FieldQueueAttrRow  ($84B3, physical 0x0C4C3; unit 6 (banks 6/7 at $8000-$BFFF; fixed 30/31 above))
; Queues the exposed attribute row (two horizontal runs, split at the nametable edge).
; Entry: called by U06_FieldStreamScroll.
; Calls U06_FieldFetchAttrByte. Touches the VRAM update buffer. Reads FieldVramAddr,
; FieldRunSplit, FieldRunLen, VramBufIndex. Writes FieldVramAddr, FieldRunSplit,
; FieldRunLen, VramBufIndex.
; U06_FieldFetchAttrByte  ($8539, physical 0x0C549; unit 6 (banks 6/7 at $8000-$BFFF; fixed 30/31 above))
; Fetches an attribute byte; near the 240-line seam it merges the nibbles of two map
; rows because the attribute grid does not line up with the 16-pixel map rows there.
; Entry: called by U06_FieldQueueAttrRow.
; Reads FieldMapPtr, FieldMetaDefPtr, ScrollYPpu, ScrollVelY. Writes FieldMetaDefPtr.
; U06_FieldAttrColumnPtr  ($858B, physical 0x0C59B; unit 6 (banks 6/7 at $8000-$BFFF; fixed 30/31 above))
; Attribute-map pointer of the column being exposed (right or left edge).
; Entry: called by U06_FieldStreamScroll.
; Reads FieldMapBase, ScrollVelX. Writes FieldMapPtr.
; U06_FieldAttrColumnVramAddr  ($85A6, physical 0x0C5B6; unit 6 (banks 6/7 at $8000-$BFFF; fixed 30/31 above))
; Attribute-table address of the exposed attribute column.
; Entry: called by U06_FieldStreamScroll.
; Calls U06_FieldAttrColumnTable. Reads ScrollYPpu. Writes FieldVramAddr.
; U06_FieldAttrColumnTable  ($85BF, physical 0x0C5CF; unit 6 (banks 6/7 at $8000-$BFFF; fixed 30/31 above))
; Selects $23C0/$27C0 for the exposed attribute column.
; Entry: called by U06_FieldAttrColumnVramAddr.
; Reads ScrollX, ScrollVelX.
; U06_FieldQueueAttrColumn  ($85F2, physical 0x0C602; unit 6 (banks 6/7 at $8000-$BFFF; fixed 30/31 above))
; Queues the exposed attribute column with the VramBuffer attribute-column format ($C0

; VramBufIndex.

; U10_CloseupAnimateA  ($AB9A, physical 0x16BAA; unit 10 (banks 10/11 at $8000-$BFFF; fixed 30/31 above))

; pitcher at ($D0, $C0/$40 by PitcherSide), draws his uniform number (PitcherNumber, one
; or two digit sprites at the offset given for frame ObjectTable+$10 & 3) and the
; frame's metasprite (mirrored drawer when PitcherSide bit 6 is set), waits for the IRQ
; split and loads its CHR split banks; every 16 frames advances the frame and after 4
; frames returns to state $10 with PitcherCloseupDelay = 1. Any other state goes to
; U10_PitcherCloseupStrikeout.

; Calls U10_CloseupAnimateA, U10_PitcherCloseupStrikeout, U10_DrawMetaspriteMirrored,
; DrawMetasprite. Touches the OAM shadow page. Reads LoopCounter, IrqCount, OamCursor,
; ObjectTable, PitcherSide, PitcherNumber. Writes ChrSplitNibbles, OamCursor,
; ObjectTable, PitcherCloseupDelay, OamBuffer.
; Sprite tile per digit 0-9 of the pitcher's uniform number (16 bytes).

; Shares the $8007 scene-record loader with units 10/12 (see unit10.asm). Entry 1 sets up
; the next season or championship-series game from the schedule (opponent, home/away,
; start time on the stadium clock); entry 2 checks a password's game count against the
; schedule. Schedule: 6 match bytes per day at $AC5A (two team nibbles, $FF = none).
; Unit id byte = 14 (the bank number). FarCall reads it at $8000 to remember which unit
; to restore; Reset checks the fixed bank's copy.
